An earlier 20 Apr 2023 ICE report documents Hoffmann publicly urging Gallant to regularize authority/conditions and a warning that residents could be left without local response to suspicious-person reports. Notion WARN-130 upgraded from Retrospective to Both; no duplicate created.
gaps: The contemporaneous material supports the institutional/operational-readiness portion and direct Gallant delivery chain, but does not independently verify the later-reported weapons, 5–6 versus 16 squad staffing, or vehicle figures.
